scope: Effective parameters conditional on CAD inertia and encoder/ESKF observations; input source is parameters.input_source. Measured-current model approximates cogging torque using deployed compensation table; whole-run holdout; no independent ground-position truth. Offsets are fitted nuisance terms, not sensor calibration.

yaw_candidate.scope: Slow-turn data give implausibly small torque gain. Keep as diagnostic; do not replace yaw mechanics with this fit.

sensor_noise.scope: Fixed stand noise only; not a six-pose calibration or thermal characterization.

encoder.scope: AS5600 quantization and deployed alpha-beta time constant; not independent wheel-radius calibration.
